propositions: Author a new Pass-1 overlay prompt file (code-review-concurrency.md) that applies the lockset-first quartet rubric to detect unlocked-twin races where a new accessor bypasses sibling-accessor serialization discipline.

The rubric must enforce the four-element race quartet: named concurrency source, shared mutable resource, ≥2 concurrent executors with cited spawn points, and interleaving window with concrete harm (lost update, double-processing, corrupted invariant, deadlock).

The prompt must include disposition-aware guard-suppression rules that defer security-boundary TOCTOU to the security overlay and load-shaped concurrency to the performance overlay, suppressing findings only when the guard prevents the harm.

The file must declare frontmatter keys (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt), instruct criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and state that empty findings are expected.

This story delivers the prompt document only in an inert state; registration (OVERLAY_IDS member, routing entry, content trigger, dispatch lines in code-review.yaml) is owned by the dependent registration story errable-tricksome-ape.
